notes.title: CraftCraft 1.1: Endless Mode + Story Update
notes.content:
[p]Greetings all you wonderful Crafters![/p][p][/p][p]Oak here, bearing some excellent news for you. We are happy to release our first major feature and content update, bringing with it an [b]expanded ending[/b], 2 brand [b]new characters[/b] with their own quests, and the much-request [b]Endless Mode[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]We have been reading (and reacting to) your feedback and we have seen what you have been wishing for. It was clear shortly after release that an Endless Mode was the single most requested feature for the game, so we got cracking on it immediately. Mind you, this is just the start for the Endless Mode and more variation, content, and mechanics will arrive there as time goes by and as we improve and expand the main storyline as well. That being said I do hope y'all have fun with it and we are always open for suggestions on how to improve it! [/p][p][/p][p]Some of the things we have been considering: having some characters from the Story Mode pop in occasionally, random events, bulk orders, more scavengables (and items generally), more romance interactions, and quite a bit more. However, all of it will take time and of course we need to prioritize things based on what you, our players, would request as well. Rest assured that we will be adding even more cool stuff into the game - eventually we want to add new crafting mechanics, too![/p][p]You can access the Endless Mode, either from the Main Menu when clicking Start, or when finishing a Story run - and yes, you can load your old savegames at the end of the game and continue from there![/p][p][/p][p]As for the story, we have added an additional final encounter with Saskia at the end of the game and expanded upon the ending slideshow with new slides, voiceover, and music! [/p][p][/p][p]There are also 2 new characters, Lady Maureena and Spinstress Marjati, with their own brand new quests and dialogues. We have also modified the quest structure of the day, spreading out characters that were once rolled randomly inbetween other quests to always be present. We just weren't happy with the way that we were rolling these characters into the story, so we decided to just put them all in anyway. [b]NOTE: This change *may* end up in some quests running twice for some existing savegames, but it would only happen once during that specific run.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]And finally, we have also improved the stability of the game, so it should now play a bit more smoothly and have less crashes. We will look into optimization more in the future too, we are aware that having a LOT of items in your drawers can make the game hitch up a bit.[/p][p][/p][p]So yeah, that's our big update for now! Thank you for being patient with us and please make sure to take advantage of our sale [b](Craftcraft is -15% off!)[/b] and of course, our [url="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/54671/Craft_and_Taxes/" style="button"]Craft & Taxes bundle[/url] for an extra discount if you already own Death and Taxes or want to get both games![/p][p][/p][p]Do let us know about your experience in Endless Mode and what you would like us to add to the game on [url="https://discord.gg/eczgDU5TE3"]Discord[/url] or here on Steam![/p][p][/p][p]Keep on craftin'[/p][p]-Oak

PPS: Yes we are still planning on localizing the game to more languages, we just need time to plan it ahead, we will share more once we have more details - thank you for your patience![/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.50 - Blueprint Bonanza & Future Plans (+SUMMER SALE INFO!)
notes.content: [p]Hello again Crafters![/p][p]Oak here. I'm happy to bring you a new patch with even more delightful changes to improve your experience as an artisan in lovely, breezy Windspell![/p][p][/p][list][*][p]We upgraded the engine version to Godot 3.6.1, hopefully finally fixing all of the remaining issues with a crash upon clicking on the Character Name text box in Character Creation and also any crashes with moving from Character Creation into the game[/p][/*][*][p]Blueprints have been re-worked *again* to streamline the process - now all you have to do is fill out blueprints, and no confirmation is needed! There are visual and audio cues to show you once the blueprint is full enough to present to the customer and the existing icon with the checkmark is also there to help - so, no more click n' hold, just fill out the blueprint and it will automagically confirm![/p][/*][*][p]The cash register crank has now been bulletproofed to work more consistently across various hardware, and should not get stuck anymore! If this still happens to you, please let me know.[/p][/*][*][p]Outlines for scavengable items have been improved, hopefully making their visibility better in the scavenging areas, and their collision areas have been increased so it should be easier to click on them now.[/p][/*][*][p]Erik's Compass quest should give you correct scores for sigils that have been correctly placed at all times[/p][/*][*][p]Starting rotation for an item on top of a patch of glue should not make it stick now[/p][/*][*][p]Buying the wire bag objectives should now correctly only show if you *haven't* bought the wire bag yet[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Even though we're not on sale during the Summer Sale with CraftCraft because our game released too close to it, you *can* still get CraftCraft at a neat [url="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/54671/Craft_and_Taxes/" style="button"]-15% off using our BUNDLE with Death and Taxes[/url]! [b]It's cheaper than buying just CraftCraft alone[/b], and of course, if you already own Death and Taxes, it will be [i][u]even cheaper[/u][/i] for you. Give it a thought ^_^[/p][p][/p][p]We've updated the demo for CraftCraft as well! It's now up to date with the latest crafting systems and quality of life improvements! Savegames from the demo are *NOT* compatible with the full game, but we have discussed the possbility of having that option in the future. No promises yet, though.[/p][p][/p][p]Additionally, I'm happy to give you an update some of our future plans with CraftCraft![/p][p]We've been reading through all of the feedback you've left us on the Steam discussions, on Discord, on our e-mail together with Leene, and we have identified some features that are pretty much universally requested.[/p][p][/p][p]The biggest one of those is an Endless Mode. I'm happy to say that we have already started work on that! It's hard to give you an estimation when exactly it will land, but I'm going to put my full focus on it starting next week. We will also likely have a limited "beta test" for that once we get the actual loop going with generating customers and their requests, but it's too early to talk about specifics here. It is coming, hopefully during the summer (fingers crossed) as soon as we feel satisfied with it. If we need testers for the Endless Mode, I'll let y'all know here and on [url="https://discord.gg/eczgDU5TE3"]Discord[/url].[/p][p]Furthermore, we are still improving the user experience and quality of life features to make your playtime more comfortable and less frustrating. We will try to focus on adding some more feedback to things happening and work on some in-game tutorialization. These improvements will be rolled out bit-by-bit in more frequent updates.[/p][p]Since we've managed to fix most of the stability issues (thank you  all for your patience about this, seriously!) we are also moving to get you more characters and quests into the game! We have 3 quests that haven't made it in yet, and we will try to get those in as soon as possible. However, our main quest coder Quiji will be taking a well-earned vacation for the next 2 weeks, so we don't yet know exactly when those quests will arrive, but it will likely together be with some of the UX/QoL improvements that I just teased. Also - did you know Quiji has made other games before as well? Check out their game [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1605520/The_Black_Pepper_Crew/"]The Black Pepper Crew[/url] right here on Steam![/p][p]Of course, we're also going to focus on any critical bugs that may arise, and we do still have a few less annoying ones in the pipeline, but do know that we are constantly improving the state of CraftCraft ^_^[/p][p][/p][p]Last but not least, we had a small competition going for blueprint designs in our Discord! And the winner is demonkai789 with their submission below![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44026798/293c5308d3568043b133066c3f7a86f83219b5e9.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Creepy! I love it though. This blueprint will be added as a craftable option in a future update. Congratulations to demonkai789![/p][p][/p][p]Alright folks, that's it for now. The engine upgrade has been a long time coming and we're still not sure if there are any new issues brought up with the version change, so as always, if you see something that's not working right, please do let us know. Always happy to make your crafting lives easier <3[/p][p][/p][p]I'll hopefully have more news for you soon about further updates and more content! Stay tuned.[/p][p][/p][p]Much love,[/p][p]-Oak [/p]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.37 - Maelrath's Maladies + some future plans >_>

[p]Hi everybody! Oak here with a quick update![/p][p][/p][p]We're closing in on getting the last bigger sources of frustrations ironed out for you. This time our star coder Quiji reworked Maelrath's Heaven's Model quest to lose all the wiring hassle and focus on the actual planetary puzzle part. Hopefully you will enjoy the new logic for it more! ^_^[/p][p][/p][p]And of course, due to popular demand we also added respawning of scavengeable items! Every day, 1-2 items will spawn in all of the areas once they are unlocked so you can go in every day if you'd like or wait a couple days for them to stack up. We will monitor your feedback to see if we need to adjust the amount of stuff spawning, but for now it seems already a lot more rewarding to go scavenging to me[/p][p][/p][p]Here's the full (very short) changelog:[/p][list][*][p] Items in scavenging areas now respawn a little bit every day

[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We still need to figure out how to make Umbracine's quest more "bulletproof", and once that's done we will start to prototype an endless mode for the game, which will most likely take quite a bit of time (wish us luck!)[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your support and your feedback! Let us know if there's anything else we should adjust![/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.32 - BIG Savegames & Blueprints improvements!
notes.content:
[p]Hi everyone!

We've been hard at work listening and reacting to your feedback, and we hope that this patch will alleviate most of the frustrations with the blueprint system and the savegame system.

Let us know what you think!

[/p][list][*][p] Reworked Blueprint system - unified functionality under 1 button, progress bar shows you how much you still need to fill, click n' hold to confirm blueprint
[/p][/*][*][p] Reworked Savegame system - savegames now save the state of the game at any time, except for starting and ending dialogue (incl. the part where you have to put the Moneybag into the Cash Register) where it reverts back to the state immediately before those dialogues
[/p][/*][*][p] Reworked clicking on and dragging objects to be more snappy, responsive, and reliable - pulling Blueprints from the Almanac now should always work
[/p][/*][*][p] Reworked Cash Register crank and the Bellows lever to be more responsive and snappy
[/p][/*][*][p] Rotating an item will not trigger a glue check anymore
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed issues on resolutions below 1080p with fonts not displaying correctly
[/p][/*][*][p] Meowl purring can now be toggled on and off by left-clicking on Meowl 
[/p][/*][*][p] Made wires easier to grab by making their collision area slightly larger
[/p][/*][/list][p]

Known issues:

Blueprints, especially ones with wires, still have some problems with saving/loading which will be improved upon soon.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you all for your love and support! [/p]

notes.title: Release Update: Our deepest apologies
notes.content:
Hello Crafters!

We're sad to say that you are currently not able to buy CraftCraft here on Steam just yet, because our release time has passed, and Valve has not approved the game build. We first submitted the build on 16th of May, finally got feedback on the 22nd of May, where the only complaint was that the person testing the game did not find any way to verify the "Romance" part of the game. Romance was not fully implemented yet, but it was still there. If they would have played the game for longer, they would have easily met one of the many romance options in the game. However, we decided to bite the bullet and simply remove all mentions of Romance from our store page and send it into review again immediately in the hopes that the turnaround for the re-review would be quick.

[b]We were wrong. That still not happened, and our game is still in their review queue.[/b]

We're very sorry about the inconvenience, and obviously we're all devastated. What should have been a day of joy and celebration has been one of the most depressing days of my life as a game developer. Everyone who has worked on this game has high hopes that it does well and the feedback we've had from our lovely community has been overwhelmingly supportive.

We can't wait to share CraftCraft with you, we just don't know when that will happen.

However, CraftCraft is still going to be available today on other platforms. You are welcome to join our [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/GNHBWSV]Discord[/url] to find where (hint: it's on GOG) ^_^


Sorry again, and we hope to have an update for you all soon!


Much love,
-Oak @ Placeholder Gameworks

notes.title: The Cosypocalypse Cometh, Praise Baby Cthulhu!
notes.content:
Hello Crafters!

Brian here, good news - the time is almost nigh!
The Cosypocalypse Cometh, Praise Baby Cthulhu! 

We have finally solidified our date after it saying "Quarter 2 of 2025" for some time. We learned that it is better to not make any promises when there is even the slightest chance that something bad could happen and postpone the release.

Anyways, that said...

CRAFTCRAFT WILL COME OUT ON MAY 27TH, LESS THAN 3 WEEKS!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44026798/04bef4e9b60ab68cd11731ac7f0de485f6137439.png[/img]

It's been an absolute pleasure to work on. Thank you all for your patience and ongoing support.

We are super busy putting last touches and polishing the game and excited for everyone to play, and inhabit the magical town of Windspel!

I've been involved with this game for 2 years now - crafting the audio juice for the game (painstakingly design the just right clink and clanks for your listening pleasure) and also helping to find the lovely voice actors for out characters.

Speaking of Baby Cthulhu™️ here's one of our characters Zexx von Heliope with his oddly adorable charge Shaaxh'andi the Hope Ender (We promise, this is the most ominous the game gets, it is overall very cozy ːgoodestː ).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44026798/e3b4a3e33f7a62370a27f308a6175825172af0d3.png[/img]


Not long to go now!
- Brian (Audio Designer for CraftCraft) and the Placeholder Gameworks Team

notes.title: NEWS! Mortimer from Death and Taxes will be in CraftCraft!
notes.content:
Hi Crafters!

Leene here,
I have another announcement and video for you! If you have played the last game I directed, Death and Taxes, you might know this lovely pirate skeleton character who sells you his wares... well he will also show up in CraftCraft! He will be your customer but also maybe... something more?????? Here is a sneek peek to the dialogue:

https://youtu.be/4UcNWqSWiOU

We are so excited about our progress and we will take a bit more time to complete the game. 

Here are some cool things we recently implemented:
Aesthetic system where you can note down customers asks in your notepad.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44026798/b3e8ace24a541f8c9ad08dad92f6dc7754462d47.gif[/img]

And a pillow you can put your crafts on to give them to the customer, we added spears and axes and all kinds of fun stuff!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44026798/e8dd66b47a5c310583f72e52cbd402a19a371947.gif[/img]

And here is a shop in the local tavern:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44026798/9802c53e8de82029b636b916726be8b395eaa20b.gif[/img]

We are now 99% content complete, all voice acting, writing and audio is done, we have had to take some more time to complete all implementation and programming. This game is the first game we are making in Godot, and we are liking the engine a lot, there is a lot tho that we have to invent, having some unique game mechanics and it has taken more time at points than we thought. 

The release will be somewhere in April if everything goes to plan and we have been reworking multiple of the mechanics to be more intuitive after some testing! I'm personally sorry it is taking so long but we also are happy we can afford the time to make it the best thing we can! April is also quite quiet time releases wise so we will have a good time releasing then. Fingers crossed.

I'll let you know right away when we have more news!

Take care  ♥ ♥ ♥
Leene

notes.title: CraftCraft News and a Sneak Peek Video!
notes.content:
Hi Crafters!

It is very exciting times for us, I have some news for you, both good and bad.

Let's get to the bad ones first: We need to push the release one more month to[b] 10th March![/b] 

And I am so thankful for the patience of everybody. With small teams, if anybody gets sick or has other personal reasons, the development slows down noticeably and we have been through a lot this last half a year.

We really want to deliver you a fully done experience and we are currently full speed ahead of finishing up the game!

And now some nicer news! We have finished all writing and voice acting of all of our 37 characters that will show up in the game to ask for commissions from the crafter or some to also chat in the tavern.

And for a small treat, here is a sneak peek to one of those characters and the note taking system in the game!

https://youtu.be/o3-9GzNvDQQ

We have been making the overall feel of the game better and are very thankful for all the feedback so far. We won't be updating the demo at this moment but we will also get to that after we finish making the full game itself. The demo update will come some time before release too.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44026798/a83f1b950f4bc4b4213b57a89753eb330b76fcc4.png[/img]

It is a lot of fun making this and we work hard (while staying healthy) to bring you an awesome game. Very excited about it! Thanks again for the patience!

Stay strong, good things are coming! ♡
Leene

notes.title: CraftCraft updates!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Oak here from Placeholder Gameworks.

We've been hard at work with both CraftCraft and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1704180/Broken_Alliance/]Broken Alliance[/url], and I thought I would share some updates with y'all!


CraftCraft has been taking shape wonderfully the past few months. We have some fun new mechanics, a very early playable build (we will have something to share about a demo in the future, I swear! ^_^), awesome new art and a lot of cool ideas for the plot of the game.

So far our goal has been to get the base of the game working so we can test out the features we want in the game. Right now we're working on adding more options to craft stuff at your crafting desk, where you can combine pieces of material together or even cut them to size. In addition, there is a smithing minigame that we're testing out, and so far it has proven to be quite fun! You can pick and choose what you want to make, and then hammer it into shape using a specific rhythm.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44026798/e6a3da572031c4db54da0520e266deedf4516153.gif[/img]


And if you haven't met some of the townsfolk from our trailer yet, do check them out! To join them, here's the Tomekeeper, a scholar from the Carnival of Strays: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44026798/6fb75b30f7d3c0415a112a4ee891105df82e31cd.jpg[/img]


Oh and did I already mention we have character creation like in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1704180/Broken_Alliance/]Broken Alliance[/url]? >_>

Well, we do, and here's a few things of fashion you could wear:


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44026798/6963115bb586d3e37a5e1aa5141899f990df81b2.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44026798/d42e93b921b9265014a0eef1ce5f2b8cd927d435.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44026798/eadfbb57b78fc08eb3648c55895065c24824d569.png[/img]

And last but not least, our partner Hawthorn Games has given us the chance to participate in the ChinaJoy festival here on Steam! If you're coming from the festival page, here is a warm welcome for you on behalf of both of our teams :)

Also, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1643180/Artist_Life_Simulator/]Artist Life Simulator[/url], a game we helped publish, is on sale right now at -50% off too!


And with that, for this time, I bid you goodbye! Do wishlist [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1704180/Broken_Alliance/]Broken Alliance[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2226430/CraftCraft_Fantasy_Merchant_Simulator/]CraftCraft[/url] to stay up to date with more posts like these!

Till next time.

Much love,
-Oak
